sources.title: tftransformers/bart-base · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: BART is a transformer encoder-encoder (seq2seq) model with a bidirectional (BERT-like) encoder and an autoregressive (GPT-like) decoder. BART is pre-trained by (1) corrupting text with an arbitrary noising function, and (2) learning a model to reconstruct the original text.

sources.title: bart-base: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview bart-base is a transformer encoder-decoder sequence-to-sequence model built by facebook that corrupts text during pre-training and learns to reconstruct the original, enabling both generation and comprehension tasks.
